issue.description:
## Genesis Bead
Tied to plan: /home/coding/TWILL/docs/plan/plan.md

## Overview
TWILL (Transcripts Woven Into Lasting Lessons) distills raw agent session transcripts into reviewed, routed, measured lessons about this environment. Independent of agent-transcript-archive: own repo, own schedule, own cursor over raw session JSONL, never reads graph.db (operator decision 2026-09-19).

## Progress
- [ ] Phase 0: Walking skeleton
- [ ] Phase 1: Reader, cursor, redactor, store
- [ ] Phase 2: Detectors D-01..D-06 + digest
- [ ] Phase 3: Rule corpus, coverage, ranking
- [ ] Phase 4: Explain
- [ ] Phase 5: Routing, apply, review states
- [ ] Phase 6: Measure, escalate, retire
- [ ] Phase 7: Other hosts
- [ ] Phase 8 (optional, gated on Open Question 3): retrieval handoff to WARP / NEEDLE PromptBuilder

## Open questions (plan section 16)
1 org-rule-guard denial log ownership (Phase 2) | 2 Explain model + weekly budget (Phase 4) | 3 WARP/NEEDLE handoff schema (Phase 8) | 4 how other hosts are pulled (Phase 7) | 5 observation retention vs DB budget (Phase 6) | 6 whether to detect fabricated work (Phase 6)
issue.title: Genesis: TWILL Implementation

issue.title: Implement the versioned detector registry with per-detector isolation

issue.close_reason: All five fresh-eyes verification rounds applied. Round 1 (25 findings): registry had no path to the ingest write path (3 detectors claimable against an empty table); four bundles split (guardrails, doctor, lock/contract, install/timers); eight coverage gaps filled. Round 2 (22): stop-ship secret test claimable before anything wrote to the DB; schema/migration, config/enumeration, budget splits; two beads cited plan text that did not exist, fixed by adding EC-15 and EC-16. Round 3 (19): dismiss verb, artifact write invariants, detect driver and per-detector count tests added; a locked EWMA decision had leaked back open in a bead description; plan 7.1 gained ts_utc/ts_local, a meta table and the detector-version note. Round 4 (9): the detect driver had zero dependents and the ICG gate blocked nothing -- both damage from round 3's own fixes; meta-table and D-04 test beads added. Round 5 (5): batch detector-test bead was gate-frozen via D-10; timestamp population, backtest enforcement and the change-point signal each had no consumer; plan 6.5 rewritten to separate runtime degradation from build-time format dependency, and both readers re-gated to match. Final: 115 open, 26 closed, 0 decision beads, 5 operator gates each blocking real work, one ready root. Plan holds 36/36 on the completeness bar.
issue.description: Owning bead for the graph and plan changes made while applying the fresh-eyes verification findings from the 2026-09-19 plan-to-bead run: 22 new beads for coverage gaps (config, resolution rule, performance budget harness, injection/fence/kill-recovery tests, rescan-redaction), four bundle splits (ingest guardrails, doctor, lock/exit contract, install/timers), and 20-odd dependency corrections including the high-severity missing edge from the detector registry to the ingest write path. Also two clarifying sentences in plan sections 6.5 and 9.
issue.title: Apply plan-to-bead verification fixes (round 1)
